observations: Photo shows a single industrial-style sewing machine with a long arm/bed and a handwheel on the right side.
Brand name appears on the machine body as “AIG BROTHER” (blue text).
No clear model number/plate is readable in the photo.
No close-up of embroidery-specific parts (hoop/attachment) is shown.
No visible power cord, foot pedal, or working test in the photo.

claims.claim: Original Ambro Brother embroidery Sewing machine.
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows “AIG BROTHER” on the machine body, but no readable brand/model plate to confirm “Ambro Brother” or originality.
Photo 0 shows the machine looks generally intact, but condition/durability cannot be confirmed without inspection and testing.
No stitching sample or working test is shown in photo 0.

risks.risk: Brand/model mismatch or unclear identity (seller says “Ambro Brother” but photo reads “AIG BROTHER”).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the machine’s identification plate/serial/model number (front/side label) and the underside label if present.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used industrial sewing/embroidery machine with uncertain model/parts availability.

risks.risk: Not actually an embroidery-capable setup (missing embroidery attachment/hoop system).
risks.proof: Photos of the embroidery attachment/hoop mechanism and a short video stitching an embroidery pattern.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not confirmed embroidery capability (treated as basic sewing machine).

risks.risk: May not work correctly (timing, motor/drive, needle/bar alignment, tension).
risks.proof: Video of a full test: threading, stitching on fabric, and showing even stitches; include close-up of tension and bobbin area.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working/needs service until proven.

risks.risk: Missing accessories/consumables (needles, bobbins, presser feet, power cable/foot pedal).
risks.proof: Inventory photo showing included items: power cable, foot pedal, needles, bobbins, presser feet, and any embroidery accessories.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming key accessories may be missing.

risks.risk: Potential wear/rust/oil leaks not visible from this single angle.
risks.proof: Photos of both sides, underside, and bobbin compartment; check for oil leakage and corrosion.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the identification plate/serial/model number (and any embroidery attachment label).
Video test of stitching (and embroidery if claimed): threading + stitching sample showing even tension.
Photos of included accessories: power cable, foot pedal, needles, bobbins, presser feet, and embroidery hoop/attachment (if any).
Close-ups of bobbin area and tension controls.
response.reason: The photo lets me identify the machine as an “AIG BROTHER” industrial-style sewing machine, but the seller’s embroidery/originality and working performance claims are not provable from this single image. Without a model plate and a stitching/embroidery test, I can’t price confidently.
